shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && ls src app pages 2>/dev/null; ls middleware.* src/middleware.* 2>/dev/null; cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null | head -30

node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" && grep -rl "proxy.ts" node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -o "middleware.*deprecated[^\"']*" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; cat next.config.ts

grep -rho "The \"middleware\" file[^\"]*\|middleware.*is deprecated[^\"]*\|use \"proxy\"[^\"]*" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js | sort -u | head -5; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/web/ | head -20

grep -rhoE "(middleware|Middleware)[^\"'\`]{0,80}(deprecated|proxy)[^\"'\`]{0,120}" node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/*.js node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/*.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -10

grep -rlE "middleware.*(has been renamed|renamed to).*proxy|proxy\.ts" node_modules/next/dist/build/ node_modules/next/dist/lib/ node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rhoE "[^\"'\`]{0,80}renamed[^\"'\`]{0,80}proxy[^\"'\`]{0,80}" node_modules/next/dist/build/ node_modules/next/dist/lib/ node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -5

grep -rhoE "[^\"'\`]{0,120}(middleware|Middleware)[^\"'\`]{0,60}deprecat[^\"'\`]{0,160}" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js node_modules/next/dist/build/entries.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/find-pages-dir.js node_modules/next/dist/build/get-middleware-or-proxy-file.js node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/*.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; ls node_modules/next/dist/build | grep -i "middleware\|proxy"

grep -rlE "MIDDLEWARE_FILENAME|PROXY_FILENAME" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js node_modules/next/dist/build/entries.js 2>/dev/null; grep -hoE "(MIDDLEWARE_FILENAME|PROXY_FILENAME)\s*=\s*[^;]+" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js; grep -hoE "[^;]{0,200}(middleware|proxy).{0,40}deprecated.{0,200}" node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js node_modules/next/dist/build/entries.js node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js node_modules/next/dist/server/dev/*.js | head -3
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | head -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

(npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done; echo "--- / headers"; curl -sI http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP/"; echo "--- /about headers"; curl -sI http://localhost:3123/about | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP/"; sleep 1; echo "--- server log"; cat /tmp/next-dev.log | grep -v "^$" | head -30; pkill -f "next dev -p 3123" || true
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
